description: Draw calls against instancing, the same asteroid belt three ways: SEPARATE is a scene node a rock, each its own draw call with its matrices in a uniform block (renderer.instancing off, up to 20,000); BATCHED the same nodes, the renderer finding the runs of one primitive and drawing each run instanced; INSTANCED no nodes at all, one helder.scene.render.InstancedMesh whose transforms and colours the program writes into flat arrays, one draw for up to 200,000 rocks.

Every rock orbits and spins every frame on the CPU, so the overlay's CPU time is the frame's real work: the update, the renderer's extraction and recording. The slider sets how many (logarithmic), the buttons the mode, keys 1 to 3 too. It starts at 100,000 instances and halves that, down to 10,000, while a slow GPU (a software one, CI's) cannot keep up, until the slider is touched.
